title: Welcome aboard
heroBody: Let's get Bagel ready for your channel. We'll cover the essentials, then you can choose how much Bagel should do.
consentBody: Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before proceeding.
consentLabel: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy
choiceBody: Pick the setup that fits your channel.
choiceNewBody: Default setup with a guided tour.
choiceNewPreview: We'll walk through commands and modules so you know what Bagel can do from day one.
choiceIntegrateBody: Keep modules; turn off built-in commands except clips.
choiceIntegratePreview: Useful for adding Bagel alongside another bot. Your modules and custom commands keep their current settings.
choiceQuietBody: Turn off shipped modules and commands.
choiceQuietPreview: Bagel starts silent. Your custom commands and saved settings stay available to manage later.
choiceImportBody: Bring your supported setup from another bot.
choiceImportPreview: Next, choose a source, preview its items, and decide what to bring across.
footerNote: You can change everything later in your dashboard.
roleBody: Bagel can work alongside your existing bots. Pick a starting setup; you can switch features on individually later.
rolesongsBody: Turn off other shipped chat features and built-in commands. Song requests still need Spotify setup; your custom commands stay as they are.
rolequietBody: Turn off shipped features and built-in commands, then add only what you want. Your custom commands stay as they are.
rolecurrentBody: Leave all existing switches and default features as they are.
langBody: Pick the language for your console with the switch below. You can change it any time on the Settings page.
step1Body: If your chat uses follower-only, sub-only or slow mode, type this in Twitch chat so Bagel can answer requests there. Otherwise you can do it later.
newCommandsBody: A viewer types a command in chat and Bagel replies. Built-in commands are ready to use, and you can create your own from the dashboard.
newCommandsHint: This is an example. Add your own command and reply after setup.
newModulesBody: Modules control larger features such as song requests and moderation. Check what's on, set up any services they need, and switch features on or off from the dashboard.
newModulesHint: An example module reply. Explore and configure modules after setup.
moduleGuideOne: See which modules are already active
moduleGuideTwo: Set up song requests when you're ready
moduleGuideThree: Turn off anything your channel doesn't need
step2Body: Add a custom !command only if you want one. The Commands page shows what Bagel will say before you save it.
step3Body: Turn on more features only when you need them. The Modules page also lets you switch back to a focused setup in one step.
importBody: Coming from StreamElements, Moobot or StreamLabs Chatbot? The Import page brings your commands, timers and the rest over automatically instead of rebuilding them by hand.
saveError: Could not apply your setup. Nothing changed, press Finish setup to try again.
